# 2025 Coding Standards
- Always use **Mobile-First** responsive design.
- Strictly avoid `id` for styling; use **classes** only.
- Never use percentages for layout. Use **Flexbox** or **CSS Grid** exclusively.
- Use **Semantic HTML tags** (e.g., `<section>`, `<article>`, `<header>`) instead of generic `<div>` blocks.
- Prefer **Tailwind CSS** or modern CSS variables for styling.
- Ensure all code follows modern ES6+ standards for JavaScript.
